title: Misspelling is driving me nuts
text:
Misspelling is driving me nuts. We are dog people through and through. Our kitchen curtains in our RV have dogs on them and our 6 dogs go almost everywhere we go. I love the sentiment of this towel because it is very true.... Every meal and bite we take, they are WATCHING us.
This towel is more decorative than useful. It's thin and still stiff are going through the laundry. Plus the use of the incorrect tense makes me not want to use this thing.
